detail.title: 4MP WizMind Dual-Lens People Counting Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-HDW8441X-3D 4MP WizMind Dual-Lens People Counting Network Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4 MP Resolution • Built-in Mic & Speaker: Secure Real-Time Talk • Binocular Stereo Vision and Deep Learning Algorithms for Improved Detection Accuracy • People Counting and Queue Management for Customer Traffic Analytics • Supports Crowd Detection, Prevent Overcrowding Risks with Instant Alerts • Supports Leave Post Detection for Real-time Safety Alerts • Built-in IR LED, the Max. Illumination Distance is 20 m • IP67 and IK10 Protection Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: 2.0 mm: 0.007 lux@F2.0 (Color, 30 IRE) 0.0007 lux@F2.0 (B/W, 30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on) 2.8 mm: 0.005 lux@F1.6 (Color, 30 IRE) 0.0005 lux@F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.Field of View: 2.0 mm: Horizontal: 122°; Vertical: 72°; Diagonal: 141° 2.8 mm: Horizontal: 95°; Vertical: 52°; Diagonal: 114°
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Intrusion, tripwire, fast moving (the three functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human); loitering detection, people gathering, and parking detection
General.Face Detection: Face detection; track; snapshot; snapshot optimization; optimal face snapshot upload; face enhancement; face exposure; face attributes extraction including 6 attributes (gender, age, glasses, expressions, mask, and beard) and 8 expressions (angry, sad, disgusted, scared, surprised, calm, happy, confused); face snapshot set as face or one-inch photo; snapshot strategies (real-time snapshot, quality priority and optimization snapshot); face angle filter; optimization time setting
General.People Counting: Tripwire people counting, drawing polygonal lines for tripwire, generating and exporting report (day/week/month/year); People counting in area, generating and exporting report (day/week/month); Queue management, generating and exporting report (day/week/month); 4 rules can be set for tripwire, people counting in area and queue management; Supports crowd detection; Supports intelligence trajectory.
General.Abnormal Behavior Analysis: Leave post detection which triggers alarms when no one is in the detection area, personnel have left their post or there is an abnormal number of people on duty in the detection area. Supports setting up to 20 personnel on duty at the same time.
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by the sub stream)
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 32 kbps–8192 kbps H.265: 12 kbps–8192 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; tripwire; intrusion; fast moving; abandoned object; missing object; loitering detection; people gathering; parking detection; scene changing; audio detection; voltage detection; external alarm; face detection; In Area No.; stay alarm; people counting; abnormal number of people detection; security exception
General.Cyber Security: Video encryption; Firmware encryption; Configuration encryption; Digest; WSSE; Account lockout; Security logs; IP/MAC filtering; Generation and importing of X.509 certification; syslog; HTTPS; 802.1x; Trusted boot; Trusted execution; Trusted upgrade
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; PPPoE; SNMP; P2P
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 512 GB); NAS
General.Browser: IE: IE 9 and later Chrome Firefox Safari: Safari 12 and later
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1 CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU; FCC:47 CFR FCC Part 15, Subpart B; UL/CUL: UL62368-1 & CAN/CSA C22.2 No. 62368-1-14
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 4 W (12 VDC); 6.4 W (PoE) Max. (H.265+main stream/IR intensity+IR on): 11.3 W (12 VDC); 12.9 W (PoE)
